replied.post_title: What Happens After a Free Control Link?
replied.reply_text: Great poll question! From my experience, it really depends on the viewer - some leave a tip right away, others stick around chatting and gradually become regulars. The Free Control Link is such a great icebreaker because it lowers the barrier to interact. I have noticed that viewers who engage through it are more likely to return, since they have already had a positive experience. How has everyone else found it affects viewer retention?
